\section[\texorpdfstring{\pa{ਕਾਲਜ} (kālaj)}{ਕਾਲਜ (kālaj)}]{\pa{ਕਾਲਜ} (kālaj) — a college}

\label{lesson:PA-C361-kalaj}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Punjabi for a result, then the Punjabi for passed.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \pa{ਕਾਲਜ}}
\textbf{\pa{ਕਾਲਜ}} — \emph{kālaj} — \textquotedblleft{}a college\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\pa{ਮੇਰੀ} \pa{ਭੈਣ} \pa{ਕਾਲਜ} \pa{ਵਿੱਚ} \pa{ਪੜ੍ਹਦੀ} \pa{ਹੈ।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{merī bhaiṇ kālaj vich paṛhdī hai.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
My sister studies at a college.
\end{quote}

A masculine noun.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\pa{ਕਾਲਜ}} (\emph{kālaj}) is borrowed from English \emph{college}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for this chapter.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kālaj}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kālaj}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{merī bhaiṇ kālaj vich paṛhdī hai.} — My sister studies at a college.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Punjabi for a result, then the Punjabi for passed, then say \emph{kālaj} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\pa{ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ} (dākhlā)}{ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ (dākhlā)}]{\pa{ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ} (dākhlā) — admission (to a school or college)}

\label{lesson:PA-C361-dakhla}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Punjabi for passed, then the Punjabi for a college.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \pa{ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ}}
\textbf{\pa{ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ}} — \emph{dākhlā} — \textquotedblleft{}admission (to a school or college)\textquotedblright{}.

\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{mainū̃ kālaj vich dākhlā miliā.}
\end{quote}

A masculine noun.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\pa{ਵਜ਼ੀਫ਼ਾ} (vazīfā)}{ਵਜ਼ੀਫ਼ਾ (vazīfā)}]{\pa{ਵਜ਼ੀਫ਼ਾ} (vazīfā) — a scholarship; a grant}
